question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the
stimulus: sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) People praised him more than their king. (b) The guest praised the king. (c) The name of that man was Hatem Tai. (d) But the guests praised Hatem Tai also. (e) One day, the king gave a dinner. (f) He was not rich but very hospitable. (g) So, the king felt happy and proud. (h) Long, long ago, there lived a very kind and generous man in Yemen. Part B: Writing Test (50 Marks)
guide_solution: (h) (c) (f) (a) (e) (b) (g) (d) For Question No. 8, 9, 10, 11 & 12, See Composition Part English First Paper 157
